media.title: Wikipedia: David Gardiner Tyler
media.note:
David Gardiner Tyler (July 12, 1846 – September 5, 1927) was an American politician and the ninth child and fourth son of John Tyler, the tenth president of the United States.
Born in New York, Tyler went to school in Virginia and fought in the Confederate Army during the American Civil War.

bio: 6th cousin 5 times removed (son of Julia Gardiner Tyler, [R4-S2]). Born in New York; Confederate soldier; studied in Germany and Virginia; Virginia State Senator, U.S. Representative (Va. 2nd district) and circuit judge ([R4-S1]).
